limitations: Components are generated painterly RGBA, not rigged anatomy or hand-authored brushwork.
Clothing is an authored visual grouping, not attested occupational uniform.
Pixel integrity checks do not certify likeness, pupil visibility or anatomical seam quality; inspect review sheets.
Existing runtime assets remain retained; family/child binding requires the documented identity/UI work.

unrecordedIdentityFallbacks.family: Use recorded sex plus stable presentation-only variant hash; persist or version the mapping before runtime integration.
unrecordedIdentityFallbacks.children: Existing records lack sex and variant; retain generic compatibility portrait until explicitly recorded.
unrecordedIdentityFallbacks.unknownOccupation: Use age-stage default wardrobe, never infer a current profession from natal origin.
unrecordedIdentityFallbacks.legacyGeneric18: Retain current runtime generic paths; this authoring build does not overwrite them.
